## REQ-RES-META-001

**Get Metadata addresses one DataSet and carries an empty DataSetMetaData**

A Get Metadata is sent to Get/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> and its NetworkMessage is a ua-metadata message whose MetaData is the empty object {}.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.5
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.5-ff9f8200

> In combination with the method Get, the payload requires an empty DataSetMetaData. The topic must contain Resource, Source and Filter to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.5

Notes: Example V-PAY-020 (MG B1.1.5): the header addresses the Data DataSet (DataSetWriterId, WriterGroupName = Tag, DataSetWriterName = Source). The second part of the item (no Metadata for a Source/Filter without Data, optional Status Bad) is REQ-CMP-044. A ua-metadata message has no Messages, hence no helper DataSet (no Pagination or Locale).

## REQ-RES-META-002

**Get Metadata is answered on the Pub topic of the same DataSet**

A Get/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> for a Data DataSet the component provides is answered with its filled DataSetMetaData on Pub/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag>, with the ReplyTo of the Get.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component publishes Data (REQ-CMP-022).
- Refs: MG 9.1.5
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.5-bba195d4

> Via the &lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>/&lt;Source>/&lt;Filter> combination Get/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag>, the publication of this information to the Pub/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> topic can be triggered.
> — MG 9.1.5

Notes: ReplyTo per REQ-MSG-015. Example V-PAY-020/021 (MG B1.1.5).

## REQ-RES-META-003

**Pub Metadata carries the filled DataSetMetaData of one Data DataSet**

Metadata is published to Pub/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> as a ua-metadata message whose MetaData is the filled DataSetMetaData of exactly the Data DataSet published with the same Source and Tag.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Condition: The component publishes Data (REQ-CMP-022).
- Refs: MG 9.1.5, MG 8.3.5
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.5-cbd58b97

> In combination with the method Pub, the payload contains a filled DataSetMetaData. The topic must contain Resource, Source and Filter to be valid, because Metadata is always published for a single Data object (8.3.8 PublicationList, ON_REQUEST_FILTER_9).
> — MG 9.1.5

Notes: The content rules of DataSetMetaData are REQ-MSG-032 … 041, the header link to the DataSet REQ-MSG-033 (same DataSetWriterId, WriterGroupName, DataSetWriterName as the Data DataSetMessage). The fields of the Data DataSet must match the Fields of the Metadata (REQ-RES-DATA-001).

## REQ-RES-META-004

**Set Metadata addresses one DataSet with a filled DataSetMetaData**

A Set Metadata is sent to Set/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> and its NetworkMessage is a ua-metadata message whose MetaData is the complete, filled DataSetMetaData of the addressed Data DataSet.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.5, SF-078, SF-079
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.5-589a70ef, MG-9.1.5-c88db582

> In combination with the method Set, the payload contains a filled DataSetMetaData. The topic must contain Resource, Source and Filter to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.5

> Each publication using the method Set must be done explicitly. That means Set/Metadata is only possible by using a complete topic containing Resource, Source and Filter, such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Set/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag>.
> — MG 9.1.5

Notes: PublisherId = requester (REQ-MSG-006; MG 9.1.5 Set template since SF-078 (b)); header per REQ-BUS-010 (MG 8.2.3 since SF-079).

## REQ-RES-META-005

**Set Metadata is protected by ACL**

The operator of the Message Bus prevents Set Metadata by unauthorized communication participants via the ACL of the broker.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: broker, platform
- Refs: MG 9.1.5
- Verification: d8
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.5-0ebe87ac

> To prevent write access by unauthorized communication participants, the operator must prevent this via ACL.
> — MG 9.1.5

## REQ-RES-META-006

**Status event after Set Metadata**

After a Set Metadata, the component publishes an Event of the category Status about the command on Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> with the Source of the Set topic – mandatory from Level 2 on, recommended at Level 1.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set for Metadata.
- Refs: MG 9.1.5, MG 7.4
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.5-553935ed

> After a Set message arrived, the application must publish an Event message with status information about the Set command to the topic Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> (8.3.6.1 Status) from compliance Level 2 on and should do so at Level 1 (7.4 Method Element) to provide feedback to the caller.
> — MG 9.1.5

Notes: Same obligation as REQ-TOP-014; ReplyTo and content per REQ-RES-EVENT-005. Example MG B1.1.5.

## REQ-RES-META-007

**Changed Metadata is published after a successful Set**

After a successful Set Metadata, the component publishes the new DataSetMetaData to Pub/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> with the ReplyTo of the Set.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set for Metadata and the Set was successful.
- Refs: MG 9.1.5
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.5-ccacb85a

> If setting Metadata was successful, the new Metadata must be published to the Pub/Metadata/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> topic, according to the settings in PublicationList (8.3.8 PublicationList).
> — MG 9.1.5

Notes: Read like REQ-RES-PUBLIST-025 and REQ-RES-REFDES-010 (reviewed in C-027). A change of the Metadata updates its ConfigurationVersion (REQ-MSG-036). General rule: REQ-BUS-006.
